lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: Watch out, pal, you almost get hit by that RBC.

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: I am CAP. I’ve been here a while, keeping things in check.

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: You must be new. Look ahead, that’s my buddy, Red!

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: Why don’t I introduce you to Red! Follow me!

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: Hey there, I’m Red, your oxygen delivery expert.

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: Look here's my shape—it’s like a squished gummy!

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: This design increases my surface area,

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: making me incredibly efficient at picking up and delivering oxygen.

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: Wait a second, Red. How can you be so squishy? Don’t all cells have a large nucleus?

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: Where’s yours?

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: Good question, Cap!

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: I traded my nucleus for extra space to carry oxygen.

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: Think of it like taking out the seats from a truck to carry extra cargo!

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: Whoa! So you’re like an elite delivery service!

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: You're so professional.

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: Hey, explorer, why don’t you try delivering some oxygen yourself?

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: Click Mini game button and show me your skills!

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: That was fun, right? Now you know more about me.

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: Let’s see if you’ve been paying attention! Answer the following question to prove you’re an honorary blood cell!

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: Oh, interesting choice! But why do you think that’s the right answer?

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: (inner thought: hum...)

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: It's so close! Although you still have a little bit of error, it's good enough!

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: Thank you so much, adventurer! Now, time to move forward!

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: Great! Now, Let’s head to my buddy White.

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: You’ll need to watch for signs of infection

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: like damaged blood vessels or traces of invading germs.

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: Trouble like that infection!?

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: Oh no…

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: Uh… maybe you should take the lead, Explorer!

lines.speaker: WhiteBloodCell
lines.text: All done! You arrived just in time to see me clean up.

lines.speaker: WhiteBloodCell
lines.text: Hey there! I’m White.

lines.speaker: WhiteBloodCell
lines.text: I protect the body from harmful invaders like bacteria and viruses.

lines.speaker: WhiteBloodCell
lines.text: So unlike Red, I’ve kept my nucleus as the command center.

lines.speaker: WhiteBloodCell
lines.text: There are many main types of me.

lines.speaker: WhiteBloodCell
lines.text: Each type specializes in fighting different threats.

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: Wait, wait, wait!

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: You’ve got superhero squads?!

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: That’s incredible!

lines.speaker: WhiteBloodCell
lines.text: Exactly.

lines.speaker: WhiteBloodCell
lines.text: Now that you know so much about me, how about a challenge?

lines.speaker: WhiteBloodCell
lines.text: Let’s see if you can help me protect the body in a mini-game!

lines.speaker: WhiteBloodCell
lines.text: Nice try buddy, I'll cover the rest  for you.

lines.speaker: WhiteBloodCell
lines.text: Red, I think it’s time we take our friend to the heart, don’t you?

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: Absolutely!

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: Explorer, Cap, are you ready for the next adventure?

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: Let’s head to the heart.

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: it’s the powerhouse of the circulatory system and keeps everything moving.

lines.speaker: Cap
lines.text: The heart? Oh man, I can’t wait! Lead the way, team!

lines.speaker: RedBloodCell
lines.text: Wait! Before that, we have a tradition. Let's see if you can handle the Word Game we've prepared to check how much you've learned from meeting the cells!
